citation.authors: Roshdy E, Rajaratnam V, Maitra S, Sabry M et al

record.population: 39 women aged 18-50 with symptomatic fibroids (33 completed), Egypt
record.design: Pilot double-blind placebo-controlled randomised trial of green tea extract (EGCG)
record.finding: Fibroid volume fell significantly in the green tea extract group (22 women) while it rose 24.3% in the placebo group (11 women). Symptom severity fell 32.4%, quality of life improved 18.5%, haemoglobin rose 0.7 g/dL and monthly blood loss fell from 71 to 45 mL. No adverse effects were observed.
record.note: Pilot with a 2:1 split and small groups; funding not checked.
